summary: Module 09 CONTEXT: Answered micro-exercise questions on testing core concepts. 1. If restricted to one test, it would be the redirect hot-path integration test since it represents the system's primary user value and any failure results in an absolute outage. 2. A test suite can hit a real database if the environment variable overrides (e.g. DATABASE_URL) are missing or ignored, causing the application context to initialize using the production/development database settings.
evidence: Identified redirect hot-path test as the single most critical test target.
Indicated missing environment variable overrides (DATABASE_URL) as the primary cause of tests hitting real databases.
